scope: Two independently reviewed original acceptance cases on the same audited Windows portable package. Human-written summary only; detailed evidence and the versioned matrix are not published here.

N03.basis: Repeated window sizes, maximize/restore, long-list scrolling and retained selection/drafts across companion, chat and AI settings pages, combined with real memory-dialog scrolling and cancel without saving.
N03.qualification: Combination of successful subcases from two runs on the same package. The earlier run failed an incorrect harness expectation that an auto-growing textarea itself must overflow; it is not described as an entirely successful run. The later run checks only the remaining dialog subcase. No cross-device cloud draft synchronization or different-DPI claim.

B12.basis: Empty search/invitations; a stopped owned second client leaves an invitation pending; an unjoined room and its abandoned report show explicit unknown/waiting states without invented opponent portraits, resources, HP or elemental attributes.
B12.qualification: Official isolated local QA with a private loopback fixture. Stopped-client nonresponse is not verification of live online presence. Three execution rows establish one original case. Temporary clients, loopback server and private fixture data were cleaned up.

coverage.qualification: Only two new original cases are added here. Earlier source-bound evidence is not claimed to have been rerun on this package.
